title: Worksheet 12: Recognizing Warning Signs (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Most people a player meets on Roblox are simply other players who want to have fun, but it is still important to recognize behavior that feels wrong so a player can respond safely. Some general warning signs include a stranger asking a lot of personal questions, someone offering gifts, Robux, or special favors in exchange for private information or photos, a person asking a player to keep a conversation "secret" from their parents, or someone becoming upset, pushy, or angry when a player says no to something. A trustworthy adult or friend generally does not ask a child to hide a conversation from their parents or guardians. If a player ever notices these kinds of warning signs, they should trust that uncomfortable feeling, stop the conversation, avoid providing any further information, and tell a trusted adult right away, even if they are not completely sure something is wrong. Trusted adults would always rather be told about a situation that turns out to be nothing than not be told about a real problem.

questions.text: According to the paragraph, which of these is a warning sign?
questions.correct: A stranger asking a lot of personal questions
distractors: A player asking to team up in a game
A player saying "good game" after a match
A player leaving a game early

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what should a player do if they notice these warning signs?
questions.correct: Stop the conversation, give no further information, and tell a trusted adult right away
distractors: Wait until they are completely sure something is wrong
Ask the person to explain why they are asking
Keep chatting but avoid one topic

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what does a trustworthy person generally NOT do?
questions.correct: Ask a child to hide a conversation from their parents or guardians
distractors: Play the same games as a child
Say goodbye at the end of a game
Ask what a player's favorite game is

questions.text: According to the paragraph, how do trusted adults feel about being told?
questions.correct: They would rather hear about a situation that turns out to be nothing than miss a real problem
distractors: They prefer to be told only after a week
They want proof before hearing anything
They would rather not be told about small things

questions.text: Someone offers a player free Robux in exchange for a photo, then gets angry when the player says no. Based on the paragraph, what should the player notice?
questions.correct: Two warning signs at once — a gift offered for something private, and pushiness after a no
distractors: Only one warning sign, since gifts are normal
No warning signs, because Robux is common on Roblox
A warning sign only if the person asks twice
